answer: Per-claim burn fees. A ridge survey or ripple analysis, even when protected by a cipher, must reference a unique burned fee output bound to its account, epoch, and payload hash. The verifier rejects reused outputs before issuing rewards. N rewarded accounts therefore consume N fees; splitting identities cannot reuse one payment. Set the fee above the maximum reward obtainable from an extra fabricated claim. This assumes that reward bound includes all protocol bonuses; external sabotage profits can still justify the cost.
